nodes.label: Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort
nodes.rationale: Sorting a copy just to read the first or last element is O(n log n) plus a copy; a single pass is O(n) with no allocation and handles oldest+newest at once. Math.min/Math.max with spread is accepted only for small arrays because the spread blows the argument limit (~124k elements in Chrome 143, ~638k in Safari 18). Impact LOW.
